transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you lately that brought you here today?

I guess what finally scared me enough to make the appointment is… I’ve been having thoughts like, if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, maybe that would be easier. I don’t want to hurt myself, but having thoughts like that has been worrying me.
How often have you been having those thoughts about not waking up, and do they come and go or feel more constant?

It’s been coming and going. It’s not something I feel every minute, but it’s happened enough lately that it scared me. It’s more like the thought pops up—like, maybe it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. I don’t want to hurt myself, but the fact that I’m thinking that at all is what made me come in.
When did these thoughts and feelings first start? Have they been going on for at least two weeks or more?

Yes… it’s been more than two weeks. I’d say this whole up-and-down stretch with my mood and energy has been going on for about two months now, since the trouble with the new district manager really started.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things the way you usually do, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you used to care about?

Yes. I still try to do the things I normally like—like I’ll set out my paints, or I’ll make myself go to pottery class—but once I’m there, I just kind of sit and stare at everything. I don’t feel that spark or interest I used to. It’s like I want to want to do it, but I just don’t.
Have you noticed a change in your energy level or felt unusually tired, even when you haven’t done much physically?

Yes, definitely. Even if I’ve been in bed all night, I wake up feeling worn out. Little things feel like too much—opening the store, answering a few questions from staff, even carrying groceries in from the car. It just takes more out of me than it should.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating more or less than usual or losing or gaining weight without trying?
I don’t think so, not in any clear way. My appetite’s maybe a little uneven day to day, but I haven’t noticed any real weight change or anything dramatic.
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or like you’re not worth much lately?

Yes. I’ve been getting stuck on little things at work, like if a display sign is crooked or a trainee seems confused, and I’ll keep replaying it in my head. Then I start thinking I’m a useless supervisor, even though I know it’s probably not as big as I’m making it.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety lately?

Yes, I’ve noticed a bit of both. Some days I’m restless, like I’ll pace around the living room or pick at my cuticles without really thinking about it. Other days I feel slowed down, even just walking from the break room to the sales floor feels like it takes more effort than it should.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident—maybe even to the point where others noticed you were acting out of character?

Yes, I think so. Before this slump started, I had a stretch where I felt almost too sure of myself, like I really knew best. And then I’d get irritated fast—snapping at people over small comments, especially if my district manager questioned one of my layouts. That wasn’t really like me.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when your mood was low and you experienced similar symptoms that lasted for at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I’ve had down stretches before, but I can’t clearly say they lasted two weeks or that they were just like this. I’d have to think about it more.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when your mood was low and you experienced similar symptoms that lasted for at least two weeks?
I don’t really know. I’ve had times where I felt down before, but I can’t say for sure that it lasted two weeks or that it was the same as what I’m going through now.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when your mood was low and you experienced similar symptoms that lasted for at least two weeks?
I’m sorry, I don’t think I can pin that down. I know I’ve felt low at different times before, but whether it lasted a full two weeks and was like this current spell… I’m just not sure.

Can you think back to any time before this current period when you felt down and had similar symptoms—like losing interest in things, feeling tired, or having trouble enjoying activities—for a period of two weeks or more?
I really can’t think of a clear time like that before this. I’ve had periods where I felt down or not like myself, but I don’t remember it being a solid two weeks with those same kinds of problems.
Can you think of any time before this current period when you felt down and lost interest in things for a clear stretch of at least two weeks, even if it didn’t seem as severe as now?
I can’t think of a clear stretch like that before this. I’ve had ups and downs, sure, but I don’t remember a time where I was definitely down and not interested in things for two weeks or more.

Can you recall if there was a time before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for a clear two-week period or more, even if it wasn’t exactly like what you're experiencing now?
I’m still not able to recall a clear period like that before this. I’ve had times where I felt off or down, but I can’t say it was a definite two weeks or more.

Can you think back to any time before this current period when you had a low mood and lost interest in things for a clear two-week period or more, even if it wasn’t exactly like what you’re experiencing now?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had normal rough patches, but I can’t point to a clear two weeks or longer before now where I was both really low and not interested in things.

Can you think back to any time before this current period when you had a low mood and lost interest in things for a clear two-week period or more, even if it wasn’t exactly like what you’re experiencing now?
I don’t think I can, no. I’ve tried to think back, but nothing really stands out as a clear two weeks or more like that before this.

Can you think back to any time before this current period when you had a low mood and lost interest in things for a clear two-week period or more, even if it wasn’t exactly like what you’re experiencing now?

I’m sorry, I really can’t think of one. I know I’ve said that already, but before this current stretch, I just don’t remember a clear two weeks or more where I was both down and not interested in things.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down and lost interest in things for a clear stretch of at least two weeks, even if it didn’t seem as severe as now?
No, not that I can really identify. I’ve had bad days here and there, but before this, I don’t remember a solid two-week stretch where I was both down and not interested in things.
